summary: Minimal, correct fix: when locator called with renderer=None (e.g. during bbox_inches='tight' / inline backend save), it resolves renderer from ax.figure instead of the unset self.figure, avoiding the AttributeError. Matches the real root cause and is a clean two-line guard.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why renderer can be None here (tight-bbox/print_figure path). A one-line comment would aid future maintainers, but not merge-blocking.
